explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/14, first question: for all ε > 0 and large N, is |{1,…,N} \ B| ≫_ε N^{1/2−ε}? The statement encodes this correctly: `allUniqueSums A` is the set of integers with exactly one unordered representation, `nonUniqueSumCount` counts the complement in {1,…,N}, and `≫` is the asymptotic relation with a constant depending on ε.
